messages:
Rae (Marketing): Flag: latency spike in hosted inference us-central. We have a scheduled benchmarking announcement in 1h. Need status copy + guidance on sending the announcement. @Miles

status-bot: Incident INC-2026-044 created: Elevated latencies in us-central. Severity: P2. Assigned to Jin.

Miles (Incidents): Root cause looks like degraded networking between a subset of GPU nodes and the load balancer. Engineers draining hosts now. Impact: increased latencies and occasional retries. No evidence of data loss. ETA 30-45m.

Rae (Marketing): Two asks: 1) status page short copy to publish now, 2) should we pause the benchmarking announcement that includes live perf numbers?

Jin (Eng Oncall): Rolling mitigation started; observed p95 improving after drain. If the benchmark announcement is live-demo heavy, postpone. If it's a written post with historical data, we can ship but add a note referencing the incident.

Tara (Customer Success): Recommend pause for anything that could surface current perf metrics. Send a brief holding note to registrants and attendees. For status page: short, factual copy + link to support.

Rae (Marketing): Draft status page copy: "Partial degradation in us-central — We are investigating elevated latency for hosted inference in the us-central region. Engineers are mitigating the issue. Updates every 20 minutes. No customer data exposure detected." Approve?

Miles (Incidents): Approve. Add a line: "If you're affected, please check the status page or contact support."

Rae (Marketing): Updated and published. Holding note to benchmark registrants: "We are investigating a performance issue that may affect live metrics. We may postpone the announcement; we'll confirm within 30 minutes." Jin, please flag if recovery <15m and we can proceed.

Jin (Eng Oncall): Will update at +20m (1763881200). For now mitigation progressing.

Tara (Customer Success): Sent holding note to registrants and added in-console banner linking to status.

Rae (Marketing): Thanks. We'll keep social queued but not live. If incident is resolved, we'll send a follow-up to confirm benchmark publish window. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.

Tara (Customer Success): :thumbsup:

Miles (Incidents): :thumbsup: monitoring.
